answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 150598 Country: Australia Title: For the Salah al-Hajah, does a person need to make fresh wudhu or can he pray this nafl salah after Zuhr namaz with the same wudhu? Question: For the Salah al-Hajah, does a person need to make fresh wudhu or can he pray this nafl salah after Zuhr namaz with the same wudhu? Answer ID: 150598 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 807/733/SD=8/1438) There is no need to make fresh wudhu to offer Salah al-Hajah, even you may offer it with the wudhu of Zuhr as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
